مَقْصَدَةٌ [lit., A thing that causes people to repair to, or seek, or endeavour after, or desire, it]. ―
-b2- A woman great, and perfect, or complete, who pleases every one (K) that beholds her. (TA.) ―
-b3- Also, (or, as some write it, ↓ مُقَصَّدَةٌ , TA,) A woman inclining to shortness. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
